resource: Value lines in one DUR-03 fee BURN transaction (the bank part of a fee)
allocation_impact: Checked in the payload gate and before any write; never truncated. 1 when the eligible coins are worth less than the fee and the rest is debited from the payer's (Account, World) bank balance (one FEE_DEBIT value line, class BURN, OneItemFeeBurnV1 field 13); 0 for a coin-only fee. Admitted only under the (2, DUR03_ONE_ITEM_DURABLE_AUDIT_RETENTION_V2) tuple.
boundary_tests: max=1: a fee with a bank part carries exactly one value line and is accepted
a (1, V1) event carrying the value line is rejected (INVALID_INPUT)
consumers: apps/game-server/src/durability/item_fee_burn.rs (in-transaction fee BURN with its bank part; migration 0072 proves the one FEE_DEBIT entry at commit)
notes: BANK-FEE-0 §4.3 and ARCH-BATCH-ROOT-PACKETS-V1 §2.5 (GOLD-FEE-2); fee shape only: DUR03-RL-03 stays 0 for every one-item shape and for coin-only fees (D174 stage 1 text). Registered by GOLD-FEE-2.
